content_sections.heading: SVNIT Surat Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 2 for Assistant Engineer (Civil) and 3 for Assistant Engineer (Electrical).

content_sections.heading: SVNIT Surat Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Assistant Engineer (Civil) : First Class B.E. / B.Tech. in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute OR First Class Diploma in Civil Engineering with excellent academic record. Experience: 2 years experience for monitoring/ supervising the civil works, preparation of estimates, bills, measurement books, tendering process, planning etc. Assistant Engineer (Electrical) : First Class B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute OR First Class Diploma in Electrical Engineering with excellent academic record. Experience: 2 years experience for monitoring/ supervising the electrical works, preparation of estimates, bills, measurement books, tendering process, planning etc.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology Surat (SVNIT Surat) for filling up temporary contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in SVNIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Assistant Engineer (Civil) and Assistant Engineer (Electrical) under the establishment department of the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for Assistant Engineer posts across civil and electrical engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class B.E. / B.Tech or a First Class Diploma in Civil or Electrical Engineering from a recognized university or institute along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants should preferably be below 35 years of age as per the guidelines laid out in the official recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 40,000/- per month throughout their contractual engagement period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates must download, fill out, and mail their physical application forms via Speed Post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of completed offline applications to the institute is 26-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The Deputy Registrar (Establishment), Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat, Ichchhanath, Dumas Road, Keval Chowk, Surat, Gujarat-395007.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of candidates based on qualifications followed by a personal interview conducted at SVNIT Surat.
